title: Base Read File Record variant 4
purpose: Exercise the compact single-subrequest Read File Record shape while retaining valid byte-count and MBAP length relationships.
expected_behavior: The server should parse the Read File Record request as one subrequest for file 1, record 0, length 1, then return records or a protocol-defined exception depending on supported file data.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 000a equals unit identifier plus 9-byte PDU
Read File Record function code 14 is used
Subrequest byte count 07 matches the seven-byte file-record reference block
issue_safety_notes: No external issue knowledge or vulnerability report was supplied or used; this is a conservative structural boundary candidate based on model-prior plausibility, not externally verified protocol evidence.
